transport.title: Shift 2 Car Commutes to Metro
transport.description: Replace driving with metro transit for two weekly commutes to reduce tailpipe emissions.

transport.title: Carpool with Colleagues or Classmates
transport.description: Share rides for routine trips to cut per-person fuel consumption by half.

electricity.title: Set Air Conditioner to 24°C
electricity.description: Set AC thermostat to 24°C instead of cooler temperatures to optimize compressor efficiency.

electricity.title: Switch to LED Lighting & Smart Power Strips
electricity.description: Replace incandescent fixtures with LEDs and eliminate standby phantom power draw.

food.title: Adopt Meatless Weekdays
food.description: Substitute plant-based proteins or vegetarian meals on weekdays to reduce agricultural footprint.

food.title: Plan Portions to Cut Food Waste
food.description: Minimize cooked food spoilage through meal prep and proper refrigerated storage.

water.title: Install Low-Flow Aerators & Shorten Showers
water.description: Reduce shower duration to under 5 minutes and fit water-saving aerators on sink taps.

water.title: Run Washing Machine with Full Cold-Water Loads
water.description: Run clothes washers only with full loads using cold-water wash cycles to avoid water-heating energy.

waste.title: Segregate Dry Recyclables at Source
waste.description: Divert paper, cardboard, clean plastics, and metal cans away from municipal landfills.

waste.title: Home Composting for Organic Kitchen Scraps
waste.description: Convert fruit and vegetable peels into aerobic garden compost instead of landfill waste.

shopping.title: Adopt a 30-Day Delay Rule for Discretionary Items
shopping.description: Pause impulse fast-fashion and non-essential consumer purchases by 30 days to curb consumption.

shopping.title: Repair and Buy Refurbished Electronics
shopping.description: Extend device lifecycles and buy certified refurbished electronics instead of brand new.

gas.title: Use Pressure Cookers & Lidded Cookware
gas.description: Covering pots while boiling traps heat and cuts cooking gas consumption by up to 30%.

gas.title: Transition Daily Simmering to Induction Cooktop
gas.description: Shift electric water boiling and simmering to high-efficiency induction cooking.
